rows.note: Use 牛仔 as the everyday all-purpose word for a young cow or bull.

example.english: There is a calf on the farm.
example.jyutping: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 zek3 ngau4 zai2

rows.note: Use 小腿肚 for the fleshy back part of the lower leg below the knee.

example.english: My calf feels really tired after running.
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 siu2 teoi2 tou5 hou2 gui6
